input.content:
Good news — order #W4082615 is still pending, so nothing has shipped yet. That means I can still modify items in that order for you.

A quick note: item modifications on a pending order can only be done once, and only to a different option of the same product (e.g., a different theme, piece count, or difficulty of jigsaw puzzle — it can't be swapped to a different product type). I'll also need a payment method to pay or receive any price difference.

If you'd like to change the jigsaw puzzle, just let me know which options you want instead — and please tell me if there are any other items in the order you'd like to modify at the same time, since I can only make this change once.
